description: This file defines an internal class Orleans3CompatibleHasher that implements the IHasher interface for computing hashes compatible with Orleans v3.0.0 for non-string grain key IDs, using the JenkinsHash function.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleHasher
classes.description: An internal class providing a hash function compatible with Orleans v3, particularly for non-string grain key IDs.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Provides a description of the hasher implementation, indicating it's Orleans v3 compatible and uses JenkinsHash.

methods.name: Hash(byte[] data)
methods.description: Computes a hash for a byte array by converting it to a ReadOnlySpan<byte> and passing it to the core Hash method.

methods.name: Hash(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
methods.description: Computes a hash for the given span of bytes using the JenkinsHash.ComputeHash function, cast to an int, and unchecked to handle potential overflow.
